dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:control.form.c: Shown when the control asks before it sends. Only the wording changes; the text to type stays the command’s.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:control.form.s: Send only the fields that changed
Off: every field with a value is sent, so one save sets them all. On: only what the viewer edited, so a command that reads its other fields sees them as absent.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.symbol.o: Clockwise. An elbow turned through the four steps gives its four corners.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.symbol.m: A pump or a reel facing the other way.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.symbol.l: Size the card to match: connections are drawn at the same thickness, so neighbours join.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.symbol.m: Empty = as large as the card.
Used when no value is chosen for Capacity (scale maximum) on the Data tab (tanks).
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.symbol.l: A value chosen for Label on the Data tab wins.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.symbol.m: The colour of what runs through a pipe, hose, cable or wire, a coater pan, a spray.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.symbol.a: An arrowhead on straight pipes and wires.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.symbol.r: Coloured bands on the dial, and the colour a battery or signal indicator fills with.
A value exactly on a boundary belongs to
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.symbol.a: Flowing pipes, turning pumps and fans, moving strip. A viewer who asks for reduced motion sees them still.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.pi: A card follows the device shown on its page by default: the drawing chosen on that device's page (its Views tab) is drawn here with the device's values. A drawing of this card's own keeps one picture in this card whatever the device's page chooses: a saved drawing picked below, or the symbols drawn inside this card (Edit diagram).
The drawing chosen on the device's page
A drawing of this card's own
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.wi: Scene units. The diagram scales to the card and keeps its proportions.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.sc: A symbol box is 100 units high at 1; connections are drawn at the same size, so a pipe matches the port it leaves.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.fi: Fit to the diagram zooms in on the symbols; the whole canvas keeps the empty space.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.an: x and y are a symbol's
Placing by centre lines symbols of different sizes up on one row.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.sh: Show names and numbers around symbols
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.el: The id names the symbol for connections and picks its row in the bound table; x and y place it on the canvas.
Empty (none) = the medium of a connection that touches it.
For the medium "A colour of my own".
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.li: From and to are a symbol id (or a thing's id) and a side: l, r, t or b, optionally with where along the edge (0 to 1): pump1.r, pump1.t:0.26. An id here starts with a letter or _, so a thing whose id starts with a digit cannot be joined. The route is horizontal and vertical legs with rounded corners.
For the medium "A colour of my own".
The x (or y) of the middle leg of a Z route.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.id: Which column of the table names a symbol or connection.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.sh: A title, a zone outline or a divider line on the canvas. They carry no reading. x and y are the anchor of a title and the top-left corner of a zone or divider.
A title or note; a zone's name.
Zone and divider. A vertical divider has width 0.
Zone and divider. A horizontal divider has height 0.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.ca: Running parts are drawn in plain ink, not green; only a warning or an alarm shows colour (ISA-101 style).
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.ru: Make symbols and connections follow the data. A rule names a target, up to two conditions and what to change while they hold. Rules run top to bottom; every rule that matches applies, a later rule wins for the same change, and "Stop" ends the rules for that target.
A symbol id, a connection id (its "State from row"), a thing's id, * for all of them, or things:* for every thing.
The id of another symbol or connection whose row is read.
Colours the symbol: its body takes a tint of it, its outline and lit parts the colour itself.
Not when the viewer asks for reduced motion or the animation is off.
Connections that touch a hidden symbol still draw.
A badge in the top right corner. A locked-out symbol does not run its actions.
Shows a dashed frame and a badge in the top left corner.
Fans, pumps, reels and flow run at this share of their drawn pace. 0 = stalled (keeps its colour, stands still).
Rotation and flow run the other way.
A bar along the bottom of a valve, damper, door or blind.
A spinner in the bottom right corner.
A red mark in the bottom right corner.
Scene units; a negative number moves it left.
Scene units; a negative number moves it up.
Another symbol in the same place. A symbol of a piece this workspace does not hold draws a placeholder.
No later rule applies to this target once this one matched.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.th: Names each thing for rules, connections and clicks. A thing whose id is a symbol's or a connection's is not drawn.
A symbol key per row (a row without it reads its kind column). An unknown key, or a symbol of a piece this workspace does not hold, draws a placeholder.
A thing is placed by its centre. A row without x or y is not drawn.
Degrees, snapped to a quarter turn (a row without it reads its heading column).
Scene units, for positions in metres.
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.di: A drawing saved under Process Diagrams. Empty: the symbols drawn inside this card (Edit diagram).
The symbols drawn inside this card
dashboard.kit.tpl.builtin:scada.scene.sc: Which of the device's drawings this card draws, by its name. A card that follows the page's device lists the drawings in use: the first one, the second one and so on. Empty: the first.
